# Edwin Ocampo — Portafolio Digital

Edwin Ocampo builds personal software projects and digital tools.
GitHub: https://github.com/EdwinOcampo28

Featured projects:
- Global Gold: jewelry inventory and administration; private repository.
- Neon Arcade Pro: game hub and player progression; public related repository https://github.com/EdwinOcampo28/Juegos_Arcade_Pagina_Web
- EDUNOVA: learning management; public repository https://github.com/EdwinOcampo28/LMS_Plataforma_Educativa
- PRESTAMO+: loan requests, payments and reporting; repository is not represented as public.
- International Tourism: quotes and itineraries; public repository https://github.com/EdwinOcampo28/Sistema_Turismo_Internacional_Web
- Expense Manager: income and expense organization; Python projects https://github.com/EdwinOcampo28/TodosLosTrabajospython

The portfolio uses Three.js, TypeScript, Vite and GSAP for the interactive book presentation.
